protocol.seed_policy: seed=202608260000+K*100+flips; within each cell torch.manual_seed(seed), then for each replicate call torch.randint(K,N) followed by torch.randperm(N), matching official sampling order
protocol.metric: paper Eq.15 corrected hard Hamming distance 0.5*sum(abs(target-sign(final_y)))
protocol.numerics: official dynamics evaluated in batched float32 algebra; prior predecessor run checked final signs against original public single-sample equations on held examples

inherited_columns.note: Same N/Time/dt/repetitions/seed formula and corrected metric; exact row means/SDs remain in the predecessor artifact.

complete_10x10_mean_rank_phase_map.legend: B=proposed mean Hamming lower than Hopfield; T=equal means; H=proposed mean higher than Hopfield. This is a descriptive mean ranking, not a per-cell significance claim.
complete_10x10_mean_rank_phase_map.interpretation: The corrected complete grid does not support an across-grid superiority claim. The stable positive phase is concentrated at low corruption, typically n<=4 and contracting to n<=3 at K=178-200. Isolated high-corruption reversals at K=2/24/68/200 are small or high-variance and should not be generalized without paired uncertainty testing.

instantaneous_softmax_update.interpretation: At Time=10, slow-replicator and instantaneous-softmax endpoints remain close at the cell-mean level across the newly computed/recomputed columns. This supports the existing hypothesis that much of the long-time benefit is attributable to query-dependent softmax-like reweighting rather than uniquely to slow p transients, while not excluding transient timing effects.

candidate_update.evidence_change: The prior partial contradiction is strengthened to a complete official 10x10 mean-rank map under corrected Hamming and uniform deterministic seed policy. Analytical fixed-point/convergence claims remain outside this negative comparative scope.
